entry.title: MS2KR 0.2.1
entry.summary: # MS2KR 0.2.1 A packaging release: the sound engine and the screens are the same as 0.2.0. ## What's new - **Your ROMs in the OpenMPC Plugin Manager**: MS2KR's page in the manager now has a "Your ROMs and files" step for the dumps MS2KR needs. The 1 MB main flash is saved as `flash.bin` whatever its file name; the 768-byte DSP boot ROM is kept under its own name, `boot-362.bin` or the corrected copy `boot-362.ms2000.bin` (used first when both are there). entry.title: MS2KR 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **MS2KR for MPC**: the MS2000R analog-modeling synth as a plugin instrument for MPC Gen2 standalones (MPC Live III and other aarch64 MPCs) on MPC OS 3.10 or later.
